comments_text: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that the sequence of the peptide shows 38.6% similarity to Carnocin UI49. This is a unique sequence rich in serine, glycine, chracteristic of inherently disordered polypeptides (herein named as cationic intrinsically disordered AMPs, CIDAMP). Activity: Active against P. aeruginosa.
title: Hornerin contains a Linked Series of Ribosome-Targeting Peptide Antibiotics.
